en.title: GTA 6 Rating Confirms Explicit Sex Scenes Ahead of Release
en.summary: The highly anticipated **Grand Theft Auto VI** has received an "X 18+ Restricted" rating in Australia and New Zealand, explicitly confirming the inclusion of sex scenes. This marks a significant escalation from **GTA V**'s rating, hinting at a more mature and detailed experience.
en.body:
The wait for **Grand Theft Auto VI** continues to build anticipation, and a recent development has confirmed what many speculated: the game will feature explicit sex scenes. Official age ratings from Australia and New Zealand have updated **GTA 6**'s PlayStation store page with an "X 18+ Restricted" classification. This rating specifically cites sexually explicit content, a distinction that sets it apart from **GTA V**, which received an R 18+ rating and, despite containing suggestive moments, did not have its rating explicitly mention sex.

This heightened classification suggests that **Rockstar Games** is prepared to go further than ever before, potentially offering more graphic and interactive sexual content. Given that the narrative is heavily centered around the complex relationship between protagonists Lucia and Jason, trailers have already showcased intimate and sensual moments between the pair. It's highly probable that these scenes will translate into substantial, explicit gameplay sequences. Coupled with mentions of intense violence, drug use, and gore in the rating descriptions, **GTA 6** appears poised to deliver the edgy, no-holds-barred experience that fans have come to expect from the franchise. **Rockstar**'s dedication to authenticity is further underscored by recent reports of studio visits to Florida strip clubs for "research purposes."

## A New Level of Maturity

The explicit mention of "sex scenes" in the age rating is a significant indicator of **Rockstar Games**' narrative and content ambitions for **GTA 6**. While **GTA V** certainly explored mature themes and included brief instances of sexual content, the explicit classification for **GTA 6** suggests a more central and detailed role for such elements within the game's story and mechanics. This move is likely to be a major talking point among the global fanbase, sparking discussions about the boundaries of mature content in video games and **Rockstar**'s bold approach to storytelling.

## What's Next

With **GTA 6** officially rated and just a month away from its release, expect **Rockstar Games** to ramp up marketing efforts. Fans should keep an eye out for potential new trailers, gameplay reveals, or other promotional materials that could offer further glimpses into the game's mature content and expansive world.

content_raw: GTA 6 will have sex scenes, according to a new listing from international ratings boards. In New Zealand and Australia, GTA 6's store page on PlayStation was updated to include the game's official age rating. A similar thing happened this morning with the UK and American versions of the game , but the New Zealand and Australia versions offer one distinct difference: the mention of sex scenes. Yes, it's true: there will be intercourse in GTA 6. If you're asking yourself, "Is that different from GTA 5?" Yes, it appears to be. GTA 5's rating makes no mention of sex scenes, despite there being at least one. Midway through the game, Trevor can be seen getting freaky with Johnny Klebitz's girlfriend (granted, it's pretty brief). GTA 6's sex scenes may be much more detailed and graphic, especially since the story revolves around the romantic relationship between Jason and Lucia. Various trailers have shown sensual, intimate scenes between the two characters, so it's possible that the full game will feature some pretty spicy material. Ultimately, it looks like Rockstar isn't pulling any punches with GTA 6. Rating descriptions have mentioned blood and gore, intense violence, drug use, and more, so it looks like we're in for yet another edgy GTA game. The developer has managed to keep a lot under wraps, but recently revealed that it visited strip clubs in Florida for "research purposes." We're officially just a month away from GTA 6's release date, so there are sure to be many more marketing beats in the coming weeks. Whether that brings a new trailer or other forms of marketing remains to be seen, but Rockstar has shelled out serious dough for an ad on top of the Miami Heat's arena in Florida and has begun placing ads in New York as of today.
